**Exa's billing docs** describe a different structure. They list a $10 credit for completing onboarding, plus $7 in monthly credits for accounts that have a payment method on file. content.text:
## Free tier comparison

| | **Firecrawl** | **Exa** | **Tavily** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free allowance** | 1,000 credits/month | One-time signup credit plus a small monthly credit (sources conflict, see below) | 1,000 credits/month |
| **Rollover** | No | No (monthly credits expire) | No (credits reset on the 1st of each month) |
| **Credit card** | Not required | The $7 monthly credit needs a payment method on file, per the billing docs | Not required |
| **Cost per call** | Scrape, crawl, map and monitor cost 1 credit per page. Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. | Search is $7 per 1k requests and Contents is $1 per 1k pages | Credit-based. Pay-as-you-go is $0.008 per credit. |
| **Limits** | 2 concurrent requests and low rate limits | Not found | Not found |
| **Past the free tier** | Hobby is 5,000 credits/month. Standard is 100,000. No pay-per-use plan. | Pay-as-you-go with no subscription or minimum | $30 gets 4,000 credits, $100 gets 15,000 and $500 gets 100,000. Pay-as-you-go also available. |

## Takeaways

- **Firecrawl and Tavily are the simplest to compare.** Each gives 1,000 credits a month with no card. Firecrawl's strength is scraping and crawling pages. Tavily is focused on search for agents. Your free credits go further with a 1-credit scrape on Firecrawl than with a 2-credit search.
- **Exa is the odd one out.** It is dollar-denominated, so what you get depends on which endpoints you call. Its pricing page says $20 in signup credit (about 2,800 searches) plus $10 each month. Its billing docs say $10 on onboarding plus $7 each month. I couldn't tell which is current. One third-party tracker also claims a July 2026 change raised the free allowance from 1,000 to 20,000 requests a month. I'd treat that as unconfirmed.
- **Exa's free tier is the most generous if the pricing page is right.** At $7 per 1k searches, $10 a month covers roughly 1,400 searches. That is only a bit more than the other two.

Some third-party sites list Firecrawl's free tier as 500 credits, either one-time or monthly. Firecrawl's own pricing page says 1,000 a month. Check each provider's live pricing page before you commit, especially for Exa.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl pricing (official)](https://www.firecrawl.dev/pricing.md)
- [Firecrawl Free Plan 2026 – CostBench](https://costbench.com/software/web-scraping/firecrawl/free-plan/)
- [Exa pricing docs](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/pricing.md)
- [Exa billing docs](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/billing.md)
- [Exa price change tracker](https://usagepricing.com/blueprint/activity/exa-ai-2026-07-14-price-change)
- [Tavily API credits docs](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits.md)
- [Tavily pricing page](https://www.tavily.com/pricing)
